_help: Volunteer briefings for the field guide. Each one appears as its own tab from showDaysBefore days ahead until midnight on the event date (Eastern time). Times are 24-hour ("16:15"). Text can use **bold**.

briefings.title: Indy Fuel game
briefings.subtitle: Toy Story & Family Fun Day vs. Cincinnati. Redemption Rescue is the **Nonprofit of the Game**!

contact.note: Questions or running late? Call or text Eric.

briefings.shiftNote: Your shift is the one you signed up for in POINT.

timeline.note: Our video plays, right before the Chuck-a-Puck game that benefits Redemption Rescue (time varies)

pass.label: Parking pass
pass.note: Print it and place it on your dashboard. Eric will have a few printed copies in case you forget.

sections.title: Arrival & parking
steps: Park in the **staff lot** (there is a sign). The parking pass has a map.
Put your **printed parking pass** on your dashboard.
Enter at the **Honda Gate** on the south/southeast side of the venue.
Head to the **main entrance**. We're at **two tables side by side near the box office**.

sections.title: What you'll be doing
items: Selling **Chuck-a-Puck** foam pucks at our entrance table and around the concourse. **The rescue keeps 60% of every sale!**
Chatting with fans and staffing our rescue table: answering questions, accepting donations, and sharing how to adopt, foster and volunteer.
Helping set up our table and materials before doors open.
The most helpful thing you can bring is a **friendly, outgoing attitude**. Enthusiasm makes a big difference in puck sales!

sections.title: Before you leave home
checklist: Redemption Rescue shirt (any RR shirt works; no shirt? We'll try to get you one)
Comfortable shoes: you'll be on your feet
Clear bag only: leave large or non-clear bags in the car
Card or phone: the venue takes card and mobile payments only

sections.title: Good to know
items: We are **not bringing animals** this time because of the weather.
Our video is expected to play during the **2nd intermission**, right before the Chuck-a-Puck game that benefits Redemption Rescue.
